question: In ΔABC, P and Q are the middle points of the sides AB and AC, respectively, R is point on the segment PQ such that PR ∶ RQ = 1 ∶ 3. If PR = 6 cm, then BC :
solution:
**Given:**

PR : RQ = 1 : 3

PR = 6 cm

**Concept used:**

The line segment in a triangle joining the midpoint of any two sides

is parallel to its third side and is also half of the length of the third side.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54d2841743fd0a6f40b6fdcf2fbfb662e483b50cc3b27b40fd78759742c3cb7d.png] 

PR : PQ = 1 : 3

⇒ 1 unit = 6 cm

⇒ PQ = 4 units = 4 × 6 = 24 cm

So, BC = 2 × PQ

⇒ BC = 2 × 24 = 48 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm.**
